title: Portugal
subtitle: Everyday Lisbon, crowded squares and a walk through Baixa, Carmo and Alfama to the castle views, evening trams and the Tagus after dark.

cover.alt: Lisbon’s red roofs and pale façades above the Tagus, with the suspension bridge in the distance.
cover.caption: Lisbon’s red roofs and pale façades above the Tagus, with the suspension bridge in the distance.

chapters.title: First evening in Lisbon
paragraphs: The first evening photographs contrast the brick arches around Campo Pequeno with a geometric glass façade lit in red.

chapters.title: From a quiet park to a crowded square
paragraphs: An aircraft passes low above the trees before the day moves to a crowded outdoor screening near the river. Lit façades and a tiled metro passage close the evening.

chapters.title: Glass and a table in the city
paragraphs: A geometric building catches the clear afternoon light. Later, a meal of grilled food, potatoes and greens marks a pause indoors.

photos.alt: A pale geometric façade and dark glass corner above a busy road.
photos.caption: A pale geometric façade and dark glass corner above a busy road.

chapters.title: The park and the evening hall
paragraphs: Trees shade the path near Campo Pequeno. Inside the circular venue later that evening, an audience sits beneath the roof and tiers of red seating.

photos.alt: A curving path beneath mature trees and beside a green lawn.
photos.caption: A curving path beneath mature trees and beside a green lawn.

photos.alt: An audience beneath the broad roof and tiers of red seating inside Campo Pequeno.
photos.caption: An audience beneath the broad roof and tiers of red seating inside Campo Pequeno.

chapters.title: Colour along the everyday route
paragraphs: A red city bus and a long painted mural add colour to the streets around the everyday route through northern Lisbon.

paragraphs: A restaurant table provides a quieter photograph between the city walks.

chapters.title: Squares, steps and the streets of Baixa
paragraphs: The long walk begins among tiled façades, small vehicles and busy squares. An iron lift rises between the streets, while steps and narrow lanes connect Carmo with the patterned paving and fountains of Rossio.

chapters.title: Roofs, trees and the castle viewpoints
paragraphs: Painted faces and a carved gateway lead towards the castle grounds. The views open across the roofs to the Tagus; closer by are fountains, shaded arches and a peacock among the café chairs. The light softens towards sunset.

chapters.title: Trams and the lanes of Alfama
paragraphs: The descent follows small façades and narrow streets towards the cathedral. A passing tram fills the lane, bougainvillea frames a terrace, and the cathedral’s rose window appears above the tracks.

chapters.title: From the lit streets to the river
paragraphs: Lamps reflect between the buildings as the sky darkens. After dinner, moonlight reaches across the Tagus and small sand sculptures fill the edge of the waterfront.

paragraphs: The final photograph in Portugal is a café table with a toasted sandwich, a custard tart and orange juice.
